content.text:
I removed the hard line that ran across the middle of the three stat cards on the home page. I couldn't tell for certain that this was what you meant by "looks off".

The repo has only one commit, so there was no "last change" to compare against. I rendered the page at desktop and mobile widths instead. The stat cards overlap the bottom of the hero by 56px, and the hero's `border-bottom` was drawing a full-width line through them. I deleted that border in `site/css/pages.css`. The hero's gradient already fades into the page background, so the section edge still looks fine without it.

I re-rendered the page at 1280px wide and the line is gone. All 16 functional tests passed after the edit. I didn't re-check the mobile layout after the change, though the border rule applies at every width.

If you were seeing something else, tell me what looks wrong, such as the spacing, the hero art or the stats overlap, and I'll look at that.

STATUS: DONE
